deploy.on_merge: A merge to main changes nothing on sinovai.com. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) checks syntax, runs the tests and the Surface conformance check, and dry-builds the Worker (`wrangler versions upload --dry-run`). The merge also starts a Vercel Production build of the repository root (Git-connected project sinovai), which serves only redirects to sinovai.com (vercel.json); .vercelignore leaves brand/ out of it. sinovai.com is the Worker, released by hand: `npm run release:upload` (a new Worker version, now with the ./public assets and the ASSETS binding) and then promotion by the owner session, following RECOVERY.md.
deploy.after_deploy: RECOVERY.md, 'Release checks for the share card': the 0% override checks for /og.jpg, the home page's og tags, www's 301, the Surface suite, the 404 page and the bindings. After promotion, run brandkit-doorcheck on https://sinovai.com/. The memory note sinovai-duality (2026-07) records propagation skew: the first request after a deploy may reach the old version.
deploy.rules: AGENTS.md: ask before push, external publication, deployment or credential changes, and run npm run check, npm test, npm run test:surface and npm run build after Worker changes.

notes: The folder holds the share card only: card/og.jpg, its input card/brand.json and its recipe card/recipe.sh. There is no kit of icons or logos, because sinovai has no mark. The recipe runs the artcraft-brand generator in a temporary folder and keeps nothing but the card.
card/brand.json uses the generator's schema: its 'wordmark' key is the site's name set in type on the card, not a logo.

The Worker (src/worker.js, routes sinovai.com/* and www.sinovai.com/*) serves every page. The HTML lives in template literals in src/pages/*.js; site.html lists the six museum rooms (not a glob: museum-catalogue.js and room-creation.js in the same folder hold no head). Each carries theme-color #101014, their painted ground, and color-scheme dark; icons: false because no icon is served.

/og.jpg: ../public is the Worker's static assets directory, with the ASSETS binding and run_worker_first = true (wrangler.toml), so every request reaches the Worker first. src/share-card.js serves GET and HEAD /og.jpg on the apex from the binding, with the headers of the Worker's other static files; every other path, host and method answers as before. public/og.jpg is a copy of card/og.jpg, and this check compares them.

Known differences, by design: the card is set in Shippori Mincho, not the page's Cormorant Garamond and Noto Serif TC (the generator sets a card in the face of its name, and only faces bundled with vectorcraft-cli or installed can be outlined; review 2026-11-02 §4.5, generator 1.9); its title is #F7F7F5 and its kicker #A4A199, a step brighter than the page's #e9e6df and #8a877e (the generator derives them from a neutral scale).
check.mjs is not wired into CI; a new blocking step is the owner's choice. test/share-card.test.mjs runs in npm test and covers the route, not the card's bytes.
/favicon.ico and /apple-touch-icon.png answer the Worker's 404 page, and will until the owner chooses a mark.

The repository root's index.html (pink accent #ff6b9d) is an older page. On 2026-11-10 https://sinovai.vercel.app/ still served it (200, 8,374 bytes), and /robots.txt there answered 404, although vercel.json redirects every path: GitHub's deployments list shows a Production deployment of febe50a (before the redirects) created at 10:48Z on 2026-11-09, after 10a424b's at 09:51Z. Which deployment the domain points at was not checked (no Vercel access used).
